summary: Tested the bidder debrief API and UI, the losing-bidder email and the secret scanner. Test file: test_v79_debrief_secret_scan.py, 26 tests, 24 passed. The 2 failures are scanner gaps that I wrote tests for on purpose. All core backend behaviour works: debrief returns 404/409/200, has all the fields, leaks no committee emails, and escapes the decision note. _flag_losing_emds_for_refund sends the email with the loss reason (L-rank and both prices) and the 'Open your full debrief' link to /vendor/bids/{id}/debrief. The scanner catches all the listed kinds without printing secret values, and both v59l bundles pass. The debrief page renders correctly. CRITICAL UI bug: the legacy DOM patcher hides 'Not selected' rows on the My bids Closed tab, so in normal use the Debrief action cannot be seen.

minor.issue: 'Secret assignment' regex has \b before the keyword. Upper-case names with a prefix (ADMIN_PASSWORD="...", RESEND_API_KEY="...", STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=...) are not matched because '_' counts as a word character. Verified: such a file passes the scan.
In zips only a file named exactly '.env' is blocked. .env.production, .env.local and backend.env pass. Verified with a zip containing backend/.env.production.

Assigned values must be at least 12 characters, so short passwords are missed (e.g. password="Admin@12345", 11 chars). SKIP_PARTS '/tests/' also lets test folders through unscanned when a bundle includes them.
Can raise KeyError → 500 on legacy or partial data: mine['rank'], pr['status'], v['decision'], r['criterion_id']/r['title'], o['passed'] in _loss_reason. Use .get().
Says 'L{n} of {len(ranked)} qualified bid(s)', but ranked holds every bid in the comparison run, including non-compliant ones, so the count can overstate the qualified bids.

ui_bugs.issue: On the Closed tab the patcher hides any row whose pill does not match /award|closed|decid|lost/. 'Not selected' (non_winner) rows get display:none, so the 'Debrief' action never shows in normal use. Confirmed by DOM inspection: the B2/B3 rows had style.display='none' after clicking Closed. ('Not awarded' rows only survive because the text contains 'award'.) The patcher can also add a stale 'No closed bids right now.' note above a populated table. Fix: add 'selected|not awarded|rejected' to the closed regex and to the active-exclusion regex, or better, skip the patcher on [data-pmc-e-page=vendor-mybids-e] since React already buckets the rows.
When rank is null (not_qualified), 'Awarded price' shows '400,000' with no currency because it uses d.rank?.currency. 'Your price' shows 'Not opened' even though the vendor knows their own bid price.
The data-testid is built from k.split(' ')[1], so 'Your price' and 'Awarded price' both get data-testid='debrief-price' (duplicate). Use debrief-your-price / debrief-awarded-price.

issues: 'Optional criteria met: X of Y' appears twice: in summary_html and again in debrief-optional.
The <ul> in summary_html shows no bullets (Tailwind preflight); add list-disc pl-5 to the summary container.

action_items: HIGH: Fix PmcLinkPatcher's tab filter so 'Not selected' (non_winner) rows stay visible on the Closed tab of My bids (and drop the stale empty note), or exclude vendor-mybids-e from the patcher.

Secret scanner: change the assignment regex to allow prefixes, e.g. (?i)[A-Za-z0-9_]*(api[_-]?key|secret|password|passwd|private[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret|auth[_-]?token)[A-Za-z0-9_]*["']?\s*[:=]\s*["'].... Block .env.* and *.env files in zips. Consider a lower minimum length (8).
Debrief/_loss_reason: replace direct dict indexing with .get() so legacy data cannot cause a 500.
Debrief UI: give the duplicate debrief-price testids unique names, fall back to the bid's own currency/price when rank is null, and avoid showing the optional-criteria line twice.
critical_code_review_comments: The debrief winner lookup looks for ranked status=='awarded', but comparison_runs store status at run time (e.g. accounting_cleared), so it almost always falls back to l1_winner. Fine for L1; for weighted awards the awarded price may be wrong. Prefer the awards collection or the actual awarded bid.

summary_html goes through dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The backend escapes decision_note, titles and reasons (verified: a <script> payload comes back escaped), so this is fine now; keep all future interpolations escaped.
The build script runs the scan after 'ALL DONE' and deletes the bundles on failure. Logic is fine; I did not run the full build.

success_rate.backend: 100% of core functions (24/24); 2 extra scanner-gap tests fail as expected
success_rate.frontend: Debrief page 100%; My bids Debrief entry point broken by the patcher

seed_data_creation: TEST_DBRF-*/TEST_DBRF2-* notices, bids and comparison_runs were seeded for the northfield vendor and all deleted afterwards (counts confirmed 0). No DEMO records were changed.
